name: Boosteroid End Session
description: Ends the Boosteroid stream by quitting Boosteroid, which tells the server to stop the session (same as closing its window). Asks first, since unsaved game progress is lost.

exec: display dialog "End the Boosteroid session? Unsaved game progress is lost." buttons {"Cancel", "End Session"} default button "Cancel" cancel button "Cancel" giving up after 10 with icon caution
if gave up of result then return
